0.description: Well, if it ain't <hex:022903EB0203>! You probably don't remember me, but suffice it to say, I remember you! Aye, I'll never forget the face of the <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> who helped me turn my life around! But enough of that!

1.name: TEXT_FESSUM2016_00347_WUNTHYLL_000_010
1.description: It's around this area that people have been spottin' 'em Bombard buggers, so I brought my elbsts down here to assist adventurers and guild members lookin' to aid in the extermination of the fiery fiends. Lucky for you, eh?

5.name: TEXT_FESSUM2016_00347_WUNTHYLL_000_020
5.description: She ain't to yer likin'? A right shame that is. Lemme see if I can't find you a better fit!
